answer_text:
Great news! The NBA Finals are currently underway. The next game is **NBA Finals 2026 – Game 1** featuring the **New York Knicks at San Antonio Spurs**, scheduled for **June 3** on ABC at 8:30 p.m. ET.

Here are the best places to get tickets:

### 🎟️ Official/Primary Ticketing
1. **[Ticketmaster](https://www.ticketmaster.com/nba)** – NBA tickets for the 2025-2026 season are available to purchase on Ticketmaster, the Official Ticketing Partner of the NBA. If tickets for a game are sold out, additional seats may become available closer to the game, so keep checking back.

2. **[NBA.com](https://www.nba.com/schedule)** – You can browse the full schedule and find ticket links directly on the official NBA website.

### 🛒 Secondary/Resale Marketplaces
3. **[SeatGeek](https://seatgeek.com/nba-finals-tickets)** – SeatGeek offers mobile entry for all NBA Finals events, making it simple to scan your tickets straight from your phone — no need to print anything.

4. **[Vivid Seats](https://www.vividseats.com/nba-finals-tickets--sports-nba-basketball/performer/2724)** – Vivid Seats offers seating maps for each arena. Simply view the NBA Finals schedule to find the date and venue you're looking for, find your seats, and follow the quick instructions for purchasing. All tickets are backed by their 100% Buyer Guarantee.

5. **[NBATickets.us](https://nbatickets.us/)** – Offers NBA tickets and VIP packages for current and upcoming games, with average ticket prices from $30 to $200 for a regular season game.

### 💰 Pricing Tips
- Ticket prices for NBA games depend on a variety of factors, including date and time, city, matchup, seat location, and when the tickets are purchased. The average ticket for an NBA game can cost anywhere between $100–$200. However, for the NBA Finals, prices are significantly higher.
- Upper-level seats often have great views in basketball arenas and can be significantly more affordable.
